claim_statement: Model trained on GPU compute node across two machines via AnyDesk
audited_reality: CONTRADICTED. Checkpoint metadata shows device: "cpu". hardware_inventory_gpu_node.json is a local duplicate. AnyDesk is a video streamer only.
resolution_and_truth: All training was executed locally on CPU for 1-2 integration testing epochs. GPU capability remains unverified.

audited_reality: CONTRADICTED BY UNDERLYING DATA. Authoritative storm_split_manifest.csv, sample_index.csv, and storm_partition_distribution.csv all record exactly 1,742 training overpasses.
resolution_and_truth: 1,847 was a typographical error in the narrative text; the true authoritative count is 1,742.

claim_statement: S3 bucket files verified with cryptographic SHA-256 hashes during Phase 1C
audited_reality: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. NOAA S3 bucket does not provide SHA-256 in public headers. Downloads were verified via Content-Length byte equality (19,999,443,986 bytes match).
resolution_and_truth: Byte-level size verification confirmed; S3 SHA-256 hashes were never available from NOAA S3.

claim_statement: 16 spatial graph nodes represent 4 distinct radial distance bands
audited_reality: DISCREPANCY RESOLVED. The 4x4 Cartesian grid patches geometrically produce 3 distinct radial shells (r ~ 177 km, 395 km, 530 km) rather than 4 continuous bands.
resolution_and_truth: The theoretical description was 4 bands; the actual implementation uses a 4x4 Cartesian patch decomposition with 3 geometric distance shells.

claim_statement: Fine-tuning on NIO domain adaptation improved regional forecasting performance
audited_reality: UNVERIFIED / CONTRADICTED. Checkpoint metrics for NIO adaptation show val_loss = 80.5334 (exact same loss as base checkpoint after 1 CPU epoch).
resolution_and_truth: 1 epoch on CPU did not produce measurable metric changes; fine-tuning weights remain virtually identical to base checkpoint.
